title: Uniqueness on common centred open restrictions
statement: For two CentredCharts C,C′ of the same NormalFrame [def-pur-diagonal-difference-frame-data] and any ambient open T contained in both centred opens, their deformation maps agree after restriction to the inverse image of T in the diagonal Rees deformation.

source.place: Steps 1–3 and change of frame; detailed proof of lem-pur-diagonal-difference-rees-frame

proof.text: The Rees spectra over affine opens contained in T cover its inverse image. Lift each affine chart through both centred restrictions and compare the maps by the affine-space universal property. Their base maps are the same parameter projection; every coordinate is the identical Laurent representative C(f_i)T⁻¹ by the CentredChart fields. Equality on these covering open immersions gives equality globally.

theorem CentredChart.restrict_eq {U V : Scheme.{u}} {d : ℕ} {h : U ⟶ V}
    [IsSeparated h] {x : ULift.{u} (Fin d) → Γ(U, ⊤)} {N : NormalFrame d h x}
    (C C' : CentredChart d h x N) (T : (pullback h h).Opens)
    (ht : T ≤ C.O) (ht' : T ≤ C'.O) :
    ((pullback.diagonal h).ker.deformationSpace).homOfLE
        ((pullback.diagonal h).ker.deformationSpaceProj.preimage_mono ht) ≫ C.deformation =
      ((pullback.diagonal h).ker.deformationSpace).homOfLE
        ((pullback.diagonal h).ker.deformationSpaceProj.preimage_mono ht') ≫
          C'.deformation
